title: CERN Doctoral Student Programme
program_type: Paid doctoral employment contract at an international research organisation, run jointly with a university
duration: 6-month contract renewable up to 3 years, with the possibility of spreading it over a maximum of 4 consecutive years to allow time at the student's university
description: The CERN Doctoral Student Programme is a PhD-level employment contract in which doctoral students carry out cutting-edge research at CERN in collaboration with their university, in fields spanning physics, engineering, applied physics, electronics, electrical engineering, information technologies, chemical and process engineering, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, data science and AI, and technology transfer. title: CERN Research Fellowship
program_type: Paid postdoctoral research employment contract at an international research organisation
duration: 6 to 24 months, with the possibility of extension up to 36 months
description: The CERN Research Fellowship Programme, part of CERN's broader Graduate Programme, is an opportunity for recent PhD graduates in physics and engineering to conduct advanced research in science, technology, engineering and mathematics at CERN. title: IMD MBA Scholarships
program_type: Business school merit scholarships and need-based bursaries for the full-time MBA programme
duration: The IMD full-time MBA programme, one year of study
description: IMD Business School offers a portfolio of scholarships and need-based bursaries for candidates applying to and entering its one-year full-time MBA in Lausanne. title: University of Basel Financial Aid and Scholarships
program_type: Umbrella funding hub: supplementary university scholarships plus signposting to cantonal and national scholarship schemes
duration: Per academic year of enrolment; the page gives no fixed award term
description: The University of Basel's scholarship page explains how study funding is structured in Switzerland: essentially, the parents and the scholarship office in the parents' canton of residence are responsible for funding studies, and scholarships from the university are granted by the scholarship committee of the Senate in addition to any cantonal education contributions. title: WIPO Fellowship Program
program_type: Professional fellowship programme of an international organisation, with four fellow categories
duration: 12 to 36 months; contracts run up to 12 months with the possibility of renewal for a total of up to three years
description: WIPO's Fellowship Program places professionals in specialized disciplines at the World Intellectual Property Organization in Geneva, Switzerland, for 12 to 36 months. title: University of Vienna Scholarships for International Students
program_type: University-administered merit and research scholarships under the Studienfoerderungsgesetz (StudFG)
duration: Merit scholarship: one award for study year 2025/26 (1.10.2025-30.9.2026), once per academic year; support scholarship: one award to support completion of the thesis in the second half of 2026, with report and invoices due by 14 June 2027
description: The University of Vienna awards a merit scholarship for outstanding study performance and a research scholarship as a one-off payment supporting an unfinished scientific thesis, both funded by the Federal Ministry and administered by the Office of the Studienpräses, with needs-based support left to the state study grant authority.

title: TU Wien Scholarships for International Students
duration: Typically awarded for at least two semesters; short-term research funding up to 3 months
description: TU Wien does not operate a single 'scholarship for international students'. Its official Financial Support page indexes a set of separate schemes: faculty merit scholarships (EUR 750-1,500) and funding grants (EUR 750-3,600), foundation grants for students with social need, the Helmut Veith Stipend for female computer science Master's students, graduation scholarships, and Study Grant Authority support. Students from abroad are directed to the OeAD grants website for TU Wien study grants.
